breakers.english: Injustice is the ruin of civilisation.

breakers.arabic: العلمُ خيرٌ من المال، العلمُ يحرسُك وأنتَ تحرسُ المال
breakers.english: Knowledge is better than wealth: knowledge guards you, while you must guard your wealth.
Nothing has built our nation but knowledge.
breakers.attribution: Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan
breakers.attributionArabic: الشيخ زايد بن سلطان آل نهيان
breakers.caption: The dunes of the Emirates at first light

breakers.arabic: على قَدْرِ أهلِ العزمِ تأتي العزائم
breakers.english: Great deeds come to the measure of great resolve.
Take account of yourselves before you are called to account.

breakers.arabic: الجغرافيا عالمٌ، والتاريخ زمان، والإنسان بينهما
breakers.english: Geography is space, history is time, and man stands between them.
breakers.caption: The road through the palms — geography as destiny

breakers.arabic: العلمُ في الصِّغَرِ كالنقشِ على الحجر
breakers.english: Learning in youth is like engraving upon stone.
A friend is proven in times of hardship.

breakers.arabic: وإذا لم تستحِ فاصنع ما شئت
breakers.english: If you feel no shame, then do as you wish.
breakers.caption: The skyline rises — character rises first

breakers.arabic: أعزُّ مكانٍ في الدنى سرجُ سابحٍ وخيرُ جليسٍ في الزمانِ كتابُ
breakers.english: The noblest place on earth is a rider’s saddle, and the finest companion of our days is a book.

breakers.arabic: ما أعطى الإنسانُ شيئاً أفضلَ من عملِ يدِه
breakers.english: A person has given nothing better than the work of their own hands.
breakers.attribution: Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum
breakers.attributionArabic: الشيخ راشد بن سعيد آل مكتوم
breakers.caption: The road built by hands, lined with life

breakers.english: Medicine is the removal of illness by remedies — and the removal of ignorance is knowledge.
